faqs.question: How do I know my size?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking a consultation for accurate measurements. Our sizes follow UK bridal standards. Our expert team will take your measurements and help you find the perfect fit.

faqs.question: Can diracs be altered?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our diracs can be altered. We recommend having alterations done 4-6 weeks before your wedding to ensure the perfect fit. Our skilled tailors will work with you to make any necessary adjustments.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery is 5-7 business days. Custom orders take 12-16 weeks from the time of order confirmation. We'll keep you updated throughout the process.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. Contact us for international shipping rates and delivery times. We'll ensure your dirac arrives safely and on time.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Unworn items can be returned within 14 days of delivery in their original packaging. Custom orders are non-refundable as they are made specifically for you.

faqs.question: Can I exchange my dirac?
faqs.answer: Yes, exchanges are available within 14 days for unworn items in original packaging. Please contact us to arrange an exchange for a different size or style.

faqs.question: How do I book a consultation?
faqs.answer: You can book a consultation through our Consultation page. We offer both in-person and virtual consultations. Simply fill out the form and select your preferred consultation type.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my consultation?
faqs.answer: We recommend bringing: wedding shoes or heels of similar height, appropriate undergarments (strapless bra, shapewear if desired), inspiration photos or Pinterest boards, and trusted friends or family members (no limit).

faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: Our boutique hours vary. Please contact us through our Contact page or book a consultation to schedule a visit. We're here to help make your special day perfect.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: Please visit our Contact page for our location and contact details. We'd love to welcome you to our boutique or assist you virtually.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: You can reach us through our Contact page. We respond to all inquiries within 24-48 hours. For urgent matters, please call us directly.

faqs.question: What is the price range for your diracs?
faqs.answer: Our collections are priced as follows: Safaa Collection and Bilqees Collection are £395 without tailoring or £450 with tailoring. Ayah Collection is £375 without tailoring or £430 with tailoring. We also offer custom and made-to-measure options - please book a consultation to discuss pricing for these. Use our Quick Quote tool on the website for instant pricing estimates.

faqs.question: How much does tailoring cost?
faqs.answer: Tailoring is included in our collection pricing. Safaa and Bilqees Collections are £450 with tailoring (£395 without). Ayah Collection is £430 with tailoring (£375 without). All our diracs can be altered, and we recommend having alterations done 4-6 weeks before your wedding.

faqs.question: Do you require a deposit for custom orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, custom and made-to-measure orders require a deposit (typically 50%) to commence production. The remaining balance is due before delivery. Custom orders are non-refundable once production has begun.

faqs.question: How much does delivery cost?
faqs.answer: Standard UK delivery costs £10, but it's free on orders over £500. Express delivery (2-3 business days) costs £25 and is available for in-stock items only. International delivery costs vary by destination - please contact us at hiyambridal@gmail.com for a quote.

faqs.question: What are your delivery options?
faqs.answer: We offer standard delivery (5-7 business days, £10 or free over £500) and express delivery (2-3 business days, £25) for UK orders. All orders are dispatched via tracked courier service, and you'll receive tracking information via email once your order is dispatched.

faqs.question: How long do custom orders take?
faqs.answer: Custom orders take 12-16 weeks from the time of order confirmation. We will keep you updated throughout the production process, and delivery will be arranged once your order is ready.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. International delivery times and costs vary by destination. Please contact us at hiyambridal@gmail.com for a quote. Please note that international customers are responsible for any customs duties and taxes.

faqs.question: How do I return an item?
faqs.answer: To return an item: 1) Contact us at hiyambridal@gmail.com to initiate a return, 2) Include your order number and reason for return, 3) We'll provide you with a returns authorization and instructions, 4) Package the item securely in its original packaging, 5) Return the item using the provided label or tracked service.

faqs.question: How long do refunds take?
faqs.answer: Refunds will be processed within 5-10 business days of receiving the returned item. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method. Please note that original shipping costs are non-refundable, and return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the item is faulty.

faqs.question: Can I return sale items?
faqs.answer: No, sale items are final sale and cannot be returned. Only unworn items in original condition with tags attached can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

faqs.question: What if I receive a damaged item?
faqs.answer: If you receive a damaged or faulty item, please contact us immediately at hiyambridal@gmail.com. We will arrange a replacement or full refund, including return shipping costs.

faqs.question: What happens if I need to reschedule my consultation?
faqs.answer: We understand plans change! You can reschedule your appointment up to 24 hours before your booking at no extra charge. Simply contact us via email or phone.

faqs.question: Can I bring guests to my consultation?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You are welcome to bring guests whose opinions you value. Our boutique has comfortable seating for your party. There's no limit to how many people you can bring.

faqs.question: How do bridal sizes compare to regular clothing sizes?
faqs.answer: Bridal sizes typically run 1-2 sizes smaller than regular clothing sizes. For example, if you normally wear a size 10 in regular clothing, you might need a size 12 or 14 in bridal sizing. We strongly recommend booking a consultation for the most accurate measurements.

faqs.question: How do I measure myself for a dirac?
faqs.answer: For bust: Measure around the fullest part of your bust, keeping the tape level and parallel to the ground, wearing the undergarments you plan to wear on your wedding day. For waist: Measure around the narrowest part, typically just above your belly button, comfortably snug but not tight. For hips: Measure around the fullest part, approximately 7-9 inches below your waist. We recommend having someone help you for accuracy.

faqs.question: What is your email address?
faqs.answer: You can reach us at hiyambridal@gmail.com. We typically respond to all inquiries within 24-48 hours. For urgent matters, please call us directly.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards. All prices are in GBP (£) and include VAT where applicable. Payment must be received before we process your order.

faqs.question: When was Hiyam Bridal founded?
faqs.answer: Hiyam Bridal was founded in 2018. We've dressed hundreds of brides in diracs crafted with meticulous attention to detail. Our boutique offers an intimate, personalised experience where you're not just a customer—you're family.
